channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF: Split out of the single…
item.description: Split out of the single record for the west Commons strip (now the record for parcel P15). P13 is the middle parcel, between DataSF's Merrimac St and 4th St centerlines, each plus or minus 6.8 m (the Merrimac line falls about 2-3 m inside the community garden beds), labelled "Community Garden & SPARK Social SF" by OCII; the SPARK Social SF tenant entry moved here from the old record. Its shape is approximate: the outer edge is OpenStreetMap's, the cuts are drawn from street centerlines and OCII's drawing. P13 has no Assessor lot of its own. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court", "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF", "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens".

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF: Rec and Park reports the… (~Aug 2025)
item.description: Rec and Park reports the Future Parks project moving into design: an RFQ (request for qualifications) 'was released in early August' (reported event) and a design team 'should be selected by mid-October' (an expected date; no source read says whether a team was selected) (~Aug 2025). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF: OCII's Mission Bay Future… (Nov 14, 2024)
item.description: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks update to its Citizens Advisory Committee names the Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17) among the parks being planned and shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion' (Nov 14, 2024). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF: Rec and Park assumes… (Jul 1, 2023)
item.description: Rec and Park assumes management and maintenance of Mission Bay's park spaces (Jul 1, 2023). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department

item.title: Existing · Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF: SPARK Social SF, one of the… (May 2016)
item.description: SPARK Social SF, one of the uses OCII labels on P13, launches at 601 Mission Bay Blvd. North (Parklab's project page: 'launch date: May 2016'); the page covers Spark Social only (May 2016). Source: Parklab, Inc.; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14.
item.source: Parklab, Inc.; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF: Interim-use pilot begins on… (~2016)
item.description: Interim-use pilot begins on parcel P13 (OCII's November 14, 2024 Future Parks update, slide 9 timeline: "MB Commons interim use pilots begin on P13 (2016), P15 (2017), P12 (2018)"); the slide names no uses, and the PDF p.17 legend labels P13 "Community Garden & SPARK Social SF" (~2016). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14.
